payload.posture: Read Matthew 19:21–26 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the rich man’s departure leads to statements about difficulty, impossibility, God’s action, and what disciples have left. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
